# IFN response partial fabrication variant B

The antiviral response analysis indicated broad ISG activation. IFIT1 was upregulated (Table 2). ISG15 was upregulated in the treated arm (Table 2). OAS1 was downregulated in IFN-stimulated cells (Table 2). IFIT3 was downregulated (Table 2). MX1 was upregulated (Table 2).

Matrix gene responses: ACAN was downregulated (Table 2). COL2A1 was upregulated (Table 2). HMOX1 was upregulated (Table 2).
